title: The Guardian: ownership and control
summary: The UK Guardian is published by Guardian News & Media Limited. Guardian Media Group identifies itself as the publication’s owner and is wholly owned by The Scott Trust Limited. Company registers also disclose an intermediate publishing holding company and separate voting and director-appointment rights.

gaps: The name is shared by publications in other countries. This graph selects the UK publication at theguardian.com; no country or URL was supplied.
The Guardian-to-GMG ownership edge is an explicit group-level statement, not evidence that intermediate publishing companies can be omitted from the legal corporate chain.
Current register pages provide control bands rather than exact subsidiary shareholdings. Their 6 April 2016 notification dates are not treated as current ownership observation dates.

The Scott Trust’s current individual shareholders and ultimate voting arrangements remain unresolved. The older governance report was opened at https://uploads.guim.co.uk/2024/09/17/The_Scott_Trust_corporate_governance_report_23_24.pdf; its shareholder description was not assumed unchanged in 2026.
Recent-sale searches did not establish a sale of The Guardian. The official ownership statement dated 10 September 2026 supports continued GMG ownership.
The financial-report index was opened, but the latest full statutory accounts and governance report were not examined. Current editor-appointment provisions were not independently verified.
No Wikidata identifiers were verified during this run.
